content: The American Diabetes Association (ADA) recommends the pneumococcal vaccine (PPSV23) for individuals aged 19 to 64 years who have not previously received any pneumococcal vaccination. If the individual has already been vaccinated, follow-up doses should be administered based on their age and specific risk category. For adults aged 65 years or older, the pneumococcal conjugate vaccines PCV15 or PCV20 may be recommended as part of their vaccination schedule.
